title: 1918 US expeditionary force into Russia

tellings.quote: the a full-scale US financed US military foreign expeditionary force into Russia to try in 1918.

plain: In 1918, according to a researcher named Dan Sheehan, the United States paid for and sent "a full-scale US financed US military foreign expeditionary force into Russia". Sheehan says this to Michels without naming a source, and he mentions Robert Lansing in connection with it. If he is right, it was a sizable American military venture that few people remember.
